content: A statement has been issued regarding the proposal for executive compensation disclosure reform. FBI Disrupts North Korean FaceStealer Operation Behind $400 Million Crypto Theft
summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has issued a public alert regarding a sophisticated social engineering operation known as FaceStealer, which North Korean state-linked cyber operators have employed to siphon cryptocurrency and probe the open-source software ecosystem. The scheme exploits trust in familiar video-meeting tools... Read More
content: The Federal Bureau of Investigation has issued a public alert regarding a sophisticated social engineering operation called FaceStealer. North Korean state-linked cyber operators utilized this scheme to steal cryptocurrency and target the open-source software ecosystem. The operation exploits trust in familiar video-meeting tools to compromise targets and drain digital assets, prompting authorities to warn users and organizations to remain highly vigilant.
content_ta: North Korean சைபர் ஆபரேட்டர்கள் தொடர்புடைய FaceStealer எனப்படும் சோசியல் இன்ஜினியரிங் ஆபரேஷன் குறித்து Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) பொது எச்சரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளது. இந்த திட்டமானது cryptocurrency-ஐ திருடவும், open-source software சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பை குறிவைக்கவும் பயன்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளது. நன்கு அறியப்பட்ட video-meeting கருவிகள் மீதான நம்பிக்கையை பயன்படுத்தி இந்த மோசடி அரங்கேற்றப்பட்டுள்ளது.

The post State Attorneys General Say $183.5 Million Settlement Requires Acima to Overhaul Rental-Purchase Practices appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: A multistate settlement involving 43 states requires rent-to-own company Acima to overhaul its rental-purchase practices. State attorneys general alleged that the firm engaged in deceptive pricing markups and misled consumers regarding its agreements. The agreement mandates significant changes to the company's business operations to resolve these consumer protection concerns.

Why PayPal wants to have a bank
summary: The digital payments company would tap a bank subsidiary for lending to its merchants, but also to diversify its sources of capital.
content: Digital payments giant PayPal is exploring the creation or acquisition of a bank. By establishing a bank subsidiary, the company aims to expand its lending services to merchants while simultaneously diversifying its overall sources of capital. This strategic move would allow the digital platform to strengthen its financial foundation and offer more comprehensive services to its business customers.
